Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing spas, wedding boutiques, and art galleries to serve wine to their customers who are twentyone years of age or older.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allowing spas, wedding boutiques, and artgalleries to serve wine to their customers who are twentyone years ofage or older; adding new sections to chapter 66.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Nothing in this title applies to or prevents a spa, weddingboutique, or art gallery from offering or supplying without charge wineby the individual glass to a customer for consumption on the premises.However, the customer must be at least twentyone years of age and mayonly be offered one glass of wine, and the wine must have been legallypurchased under this title. If the wine is offered by a spa thatprovides massages, the wine may not be offered to the customer untilthe massage is completed. (2) For the purposes of this section: (a) "Art gallery" means a room or building devoted to theexhibition and/or sale of the works of art. (b) "Spa" means a business that offers beauty services including, p. 1 SB 5110but not limited to, shampooing, cutting, styling, or dyeing hair,manicures, pedicures, facials, massages, and the use of body toningequipment. (c) "Wedding boutique" means a business that specializes in thesale of wedding merchandise.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The board may adopt rules to implement section 1 of this act.
